scope: Bounded manual C39 graphic inspection and M77 Appendix V Chanhudaro source-join check; no semantic values or universal sign-system mapping.
review_mode: Post-hypothesis visual review; Pettersson XXUUU proposal known in advance. Not blinded, no independent tracing or object autopsy.

object_identity.original_publication_plate: Mackay1943 CE LXXIV.2; original-publication join previously reviewed separately

graphic_source.orientation: As printed; no rotation. Descriptive upper/lower labels are image coordinates, not reading direction.

observations.finding: Angular contours and several U-like curved incisions occupy an elongated central region of A2, with the angular cluster above the clearest U-like features.
observations.confidence: high for spatial arrangement; not a token count

observations.finding: Triangular and double-triangle-like contours are visible; a narrow waist and a horizontal triangular edge are conspicuous. Two angular complexes are a plausible segmentation, but boundaries and faint connecting strokes are insufficient for an independently secure count of two identical signs.

Below the angular region, multiple rounded U-like incisions have openings generally facing upward toward the angular region. Three is a plausible segmentation matching the published proposal, but the lower contour is weak and surface marks complicate a complete count.
observations.confidence: moderate for relative orientation; lower for complete count

observations.finding: Faint diagonal/curving marks occur above the principal cluster and further shallow curved/horizontal marks occur below it. Their antiquity and character status cannot be distinguished from scratches, corrosion and other surface effects in this scan.
observations.confidence: high that visible marks exist, unresolved classification

observations.feature: Thin horizontal line crossing entire A2 image
observations.finding: The line continues across the background as well as the object. A1 also shows a narrow light band around the object. It is excluded from inscription counting; material and purpose are not established.
observations.confidence: high for exclusion as a glyph

observations.finding: No exact complete character count is independently established. XXUUU remains an attributed reading, compatible with major visible features but not verified stroke by stroke.

pettersson_attribution.X_description: Author says X is actually a double triangle and cites Parpola sign234 (1994:75). This audit does not independently authenticate that numbered sign equivalence.
pettersson_attribution.relative_orientation: Author describes the U openings as facing the Xs.
pettersson_attribution.semantic_status: Numeral reading conditional; he excludes C39 from the calculations because its mass is unreported and the possible X numeral is not shared with the other specimens.

conclusion: C39 supplies a candidate spatial pattern, not a verified mass equation or exact token sequence. Additional faint surface marks must remain unclassified. The bounded M77 source-join check fails to establish a C39 mapping.
